notes.title: Cosmic Update
notes.notes:
This update adds a new level at the game's midpoint. In this level you'll work your way through some familiar celestial bodies.

There are additionally a few adjustments to gameplay balance for some of the existing levels and some of the hearts, and some bug fixes. And one other secret addition...

notes.title: First bug fix patch: Made the game a little less like Dark Souls
notes.notes:
Fixed several bugs, particularly ones involving Pure Heart and Dark Heart.
 - Pure Heart is almost entirely reworked. (It can now actually beat the game!)

Added a checkpoint to level 3.
